description: Election Commission - Declare that P. D. Ekanayaka was Selected as the member of the Nagoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Nagoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of a new member through the established electoral procedure. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations for local government bodies.
